_meta._note: arena.ai (formerly LMArena) live leaderboard refresh across all 5 areas the user named — Agent, Chat(Text), Code(WebDev + Image-to-WebDev), Image(Text-to-Image + Image-Edit), Video(Text-to-Video + Image-to-Video + Video-Edit), snapshot 2026-07-20. Agent board is NEW (arena_agent_net_improvement; metric = Net Improvement %, a Bradley-Terry-style preference win metric, higher better). The 8 Elo boards refresh the existing canonical arena.ai benchmark ids (arena_ai_text_elo / arena_webdev_elo / arena_image_to_webdev_elo / arena_text_to_image_elo / arena_image_edit_elo / arena_text_to_video_elo / arena_image_to_video_elo / arena_video_edit_elo) with current top models. Top ~30-40 rows kept per board (Latest-Models-Focus). Model-name->id mapping: 140 auto-matched to existing DB ids; 33 manually mapped (tier/version variants to existing ids where they exist, else new). 21 genuinely-new frontier gen/agent models created (Muse Spark 1.1 / Muse Image / Muse Video, Reve 2.1, Seedream 5.0 Pro, Seed 2.1 Pro, Qwen Image 2.0 Pro 06-22, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image, Kandinsky 5.0 T2V Pro, Kling 2.5 Turbo/v2.1 Master, Seedance v1 Pro, Veo 3 audio/fast/fast-audio, Vidu Q2 Turbo, Wan 2.5/2.6/2.7 i2v/t2v variants, Inkling).

benchmarks.name: arena.ai Agent Arena (Net Improvement)
benchmarks.description: arena.ai (LMArena) Agent Arena — human-preference agentic evaluation. Primary metric "Net Improvement %" is a Bradley-Terry-style preference win margin over long agentic coding/tool sessions (with sub-signals: Confirmed Success, Praise vs Complaint, Steerability, Bash Recovery, Tool Hallucination). Higher is better. Snapshot 2026-07-20.
